title: Replication Data for: Exploring the relationships between eco-anxiety, eco-guilt, eco-grief, and pro-environmental behavior in the Dutch and German population: A cross-sectional study
descriptions: This anonymized dataset can be used to replicate the findings in our research article titled "Exploring the relationships between eco-anxiety, eco-guilt, eco-grief, and pro-environmental behavior in the Dutch and German population: A cross-sectional study". The dataset contains demographic variables and total scores of the main variables of interest.
